model_output.rationale: 835 denies all four lines PR-27 + MOA N30, filing indicator CI. The 271 run for the DOS shows EB*6 with DTP*357 termination 2025-05-31, before the 2025-06-12 DOS, no successor payer. PR is patient liability and no override (QMB, Medicaid, NSA, grace period, rescission) appears.

root_cause.explanation: Coverage with Atlantic Shore Assurance PPO terminated 2025-05-31; DOS 2025-06-12 falls after termination. Payer denied all four lines PR-27 with MOA N30.

next_action.detail: Bill Robert Wilson $181.22 for the 06/12/2025 PT visit (three 97110 units, one 97140) as self-pay. Verify no successor or retroactive plan for the DOS before statementing; document the 271 termination date on the account.

evidence.fact: All four SVC lines adjusted CAS*PR*27, $0 paid; MOA***N30; CLP filing indicator CI
EB*6 with DTP*356 2024-01-01 and DTP*357 2025-05-31 - coverage ended before DOS; no other payer returned
CI + EB*6 with 357 before DOS, PR-27 -> bill_patient once overrides clear

citations.rule: CARC 27/N30: PR-27 with 271 inactive for the DOS and no successor -> bill_patient
PR = patient responsibility, subject to QMB/Medicaid/NSA/ABN overrides
